PreparedFormValues.Tagline: A lightweight Windows taskbar monitor for live system and hardware telemetry.
PreparedFormValues.Description: Taskbar Monitor Enhanced is an open-source Windows application that places live system and hardware telemetry directly in the taskbar. It is designed for lightweight at-a-glance monitoring while preserving a non-elevated main application, protected local sensor collection, transparent update behavior, reproducible builds, and auditable release integrity.
PreparedFormValues.Reputation: Taskbar Monitor Enhanced is a new public project and does not claim established community adoption: GitHub currently reports 0 stars, 0 forks, 0 subscribers, and 0 v1.1.2 release-asset downloads. Its declared GPL upstream, leandrosa81/taskbar-monitor, has 540 stars, 42 forks, and 13 subscribers as of 2026-09-26; those upstream metrics are cited only as project heritage, not as adoption of Taskbar Monitor Enhanced. Current trust evidence for this project includes deterministic clean-clone GitHub Actions builds, SPDX 2.3 SBOM generation, GitHub build-provenance/SBOM attestations, immutable SHA-256 release manifests, and documented Windows runtime acceptance.
